method: Direct image inspection of all three final PNG files; hashes checked against the final browser report. Full-page captures use scrollTo(0,0) and two animation frames without hiding or changing styles.

screens.observation: Single-column source text, marked preselected sentence, action buttons and synthetic-data boundary are readable. Keyboard focus on the reading heading is visible. No cropped text or overlapping elements observed.
Habit-only preview displays the selected check dates and optional judgment without an unselected goal or monthly direction. Text, form and controls are readable. No clipping or overlap observed.

Full-page image starts at the document top. Plan/reading navigation is in its normal header position and does not cover the check dates or comparison content. Frozen and current values remain distinguishable and readable.

scrolledViewport.observation: In the actual scrolled viewport, sticky navigation remains at top 0 through bottom 59; the focused comparison heading is fully visible at top 484.40625 through bottom 515.90625. The prior middle-of-document navigation in a full-page capture was corrected by resetting scroll before capture.

scope: Visual and automated checks cover the local synthetic prototype only. They do not establish account persistence, production behavior, human usefulness, or performance improvement.
